newsitem.title: UK: UK central bank says rates may have to be raised.
newsitem.headline: UK central bank says rates may have to be raised.

text.p: Britain's central bank, the Bank of England, said on Tuesday that further moderate tightening of monetary policy was needed after last week's quarter-point increase in interest rates.
Chief economist Mervyn King, releasing the bank's quarterly inflation report, said Britain must seriously consider raising official interest rates -- currently 6.25 percent -- in coming months.
